Long-running mixed-type saturation benchmark against a set of node RPC endpoints. Measures this blaster's own landed transactions from chain data and writes a `tn-blast/v2` results JSON. See docs/blast.md

Usage: tn-transaction-generator blast [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>
          [env: TXGEN_CONFIG=]
          [default: config.toml]

      --nodes <NODES>
          RPC endpoints, comma-separated `label=url` (a bare URL is labelled by its host). Senders are pinned round-robin across them. Required unless `--nodes-file` is given

      --duration <DURATION>

      --nodes-file <NODES_FILE>
          File with one `label=url` (or bare URL) per line; `#` comments and blanks skipped

      --dry-run

      --senders <SENDERS>
          HD-derived sender accounts owned by this blaster

          [default: 600]

      --sender-start <SENDER_START>
          Offset into the HD sender space. Each blaster owns a disjoint `[sender_start, sender_start + senders)` range, so no two blasters share a nonce

          [default: 0]

      --window <WINDOW>
          Max txs a sender keeps ahead of its last landed nonce

          [default: 16]

      --fund-tel <FUND_TEL>
          TEL each sender is topped up to by `--prepare`

          [default: 2]

      --types <TYPES>
          Restrict the mix to these tx types (comma-separated names)

      --weights <WEIGHTS>
          Weight overrides `name=weight` (comma-separated); beats every config weight

      --deployments-path <DEPLOYMENTS_PATH>
          Deployments JSON; overrides `[deployments]` (and `TXGEN__DEPLOYMENTS__PATH`)

      --prepare
          Fund the sender range from master, run the global preflight, print a report, exit. A separate invocation so N blasters never contend on the master nonce

          [aliases: --fund-only]

      --warmup-secs <WARMUP_SECS>
          Native-only warm-up (gas calibration) before the mixed window

          [default: 120]

      --duration-secs <DURATION_SECS>
          Length of the mixed measurement window

          [default: 2400]
          [aliases: --max-submit-secs]

      --cooldown-secs <COOLDOWN_SECS>
          Upper bound on the drain after submission stops

          [default: 180]
          [aliases: --settle-secs]

      --cooldown-idle-secs <COOLDOWN_IDLE_SECS>
          Cooldown also ends after this many seconds without an own landing

          [default: 30]

      --preamble-timeout-secs <PREAMBLE_TIMEOUT_SECS>
          Upper bound on the per-sender preamble phase

          [default: 600]

      --total <TOTAL>
          Optional cap on accepted txs across this blaster (stops submission early)

      --label <LABEL>
          Blaster label in the results (default: `$HOSTNAME`, else the first node label)

      --run-id <RUN_ID>
          Run id shared by every blaster of one bench run (default: `r<UTC timestamp>`). Also seeds the per-sender type sampler

      --receipts <RECEIPTS>
          Receipt fetching: `all` (eth_getBlockReceipts), `sample:N` (1 in N own txs), `none`

          [default: all]

      --max-inflight-rpc <MAX_INFLIGHT_RPC>
          Max concurrent in-flight RPCs per node (reth caps HTTP connections at 500)

          [default: 256]

      --metrics-bind <METRICS_BIND>
          Serve Prometheus metrics on this address (e.g. `0.0.0.0:9100`)

      --stdout-json <STDOUT_JSON>
          Results on stdout: `chunked` (<=200 KB sections), `full`, or `none`

          [default: chunked]
          [possible values: chunked, full, none]

      --allow-chain <ALLOW_CHAIN>
          Extra chain ids to allow beyond the built-in allowlist (comma-separated)

      --out <OUT>
          Results JSON path

          [default: blast-results.json]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
